name: Trichoderma foliar bio-control
safety: Low residue; avoid tank-mixing with broad-spectrum fungicides.
instructions: Apply to dry foliage in the early morning or late afternoon. Repeat in 7 days.

name: Fixed copper protectant
safety: Use label rate; repeated copper use can accumulate in soil.
instructions: Spray as a preventive protectant when foliage is dry. Do not apply above 29 C.

name: Wettable sulfur
safety: Do not use within 30 days of an oil spray; phytotoxicity risk in heat.
instructions: Apply only when temperatures are below 27 C and at least 8 dry hours are expected.

name: Neem / azadirachtin
safety: Apply at dusk to reduce pollinator exposure; test on a small area first.
instructions: Thoroughly cover leaf undersides. Repeat after 5 to 7 days if pressure remains.

name: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt)
safety: Selective for caterpillars; reapply after heavy rain.
instructions: Treat young larvae and fresh foliage in the evening. Recheck after 3 days.

name: Potassium bicarbonate
safety: Avoid over-application; can mark tender foliage.
instructions: Apply to both leaf surfaces at first symptoms. Rotate with a different mode of action.

name: Spinosad
safety: Toxic to bees while wet; follow local label and rotate modes of action.
instructions: Apply at dusk after confirming active feeding. Avoid bloom and open pollinators.
